description:
MIT's Quest for Intelligence aims to understand intelligence by tightly coupling scientific enquiry and rigorous engineering to address real-world problems that are beyond current machine capabilities but within the ability of natural intelligence. playlist_title: PSYC 212 (Psychological Aspects of Drug Use and Abuse) - Fall Semester Series
description:
This is a playlist of video lectures for the course on the psychological aspects of drug use and abuse, in the fall semester of most years. This course is designed to give you a broad overview of research, clinical practice, and social issues related to drug use and abuse. It is also designed to help you use critical thinking in evaluating research findings, news stories, and public policies related to a variety of drugs.

Note: this series contains many of the same videos as my Summer Semester Series. I created two separate playlists, so that I could more easily change the names of the videos
